items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026 (bodies recovered Monday; reported Monday evening)
items.summary: Baja California's prosecutor now reports 4 dead in the Maneadero area of Ensenada from post-tropical Rachel — including 4-year-old Aarón (body found Monday at Rancho Richi), Silvia (30), and Ivón (35); two of the dead are minors. Five people remain missing (Rosa María, 42; Luis Fernando, 17; Rosalinda, 23; Leonel, 10; Gael Gustavo, 14), and authorities say they have no unified missing-person count. Also: 8 patients evacuated from flooded Ensenada General Hospital; ~25 neighborhoods without power; ~10 wooden homes swept away at Rancho Génesis and Rancho Abierto; 30 families evacuated in San Francisquito; 182 people in shelters. Previous toll was 1 girl dead, 10 missing.
items.title: Rachel's Baja toll rises: 4 dead, 5 missing in Ensenada

items.event_time_ist: Oct 12, 2026 (8:00 PM MST advisory; issued ~8:00 PM PDT, Oct 12)
items.summary: NHC Hurricane Simon Advisory 23 (8 PM MST Oct 12): winds hold at 100 mph (Cat 2), 969 mb, ~85 mi W of Cabo Corrientes, drifting WNW at 3 mph. Watch change: Mexico replaced the Hurricane Watch from Cabo Corrientes to Escuinapa with a Tropical Storm Watch; Hurricane Warning remains for Las Islas Marías and Hurricane Watch north of Escuinapa to Bahía Tempehuaya. Correction to the 8:25 PM note, which said there were no watch changes. Gradual re-intensification possible to ~85 kt by 72-96h; track confidence low (near-stationary possible).
items.title: Simon Advisory 23: hurricane watch segment downgraded to tropical storm watch

items.summary: Royal Caribbean's Voyager of the Seas cut its Puerto Vallarta port call due to Hurricane Simon and instead visited Cabo San Lucas a second time, staying well clear of the storm's forecast track off the west-central Mexico coast. The sailing's return to Los Angeles on Friday, Oct 16, is unchanged, with refundable amounts reimbursed at sailing's end. The ship would otherwise have had to sail through the forecast track heading back north.
items.title: Voyager of the Seas drops Puerto Vallarta call for Simon
